reviewer_exact_projections.text:
P32–174 and text/control-tag helpers are already shared and pure with supplied time:
- Narrative only alters a string response for existing escaped/PowerShell/CR line-break rules. Unchanged returns exact input text; malformed JSON caught as JsonException returns unchanged.
- Interface string options always become objects; object options are deep-cloned, text/inputValue line breaks normalized, recognized leading hidden control tag moved from visible text; an existing nonblank inputValue is preserved. Other element types remain for schema validation.
- Useful payload is exact property presence of dialogueOptions or image_prompt, including null. Missing/null/blank-string timestamp triggers UTC fallback. A numeric/object timestamp or nonblank invalid string does NOT trigger fallback; it reaches existing timestamp diagnostics.
- Changed serialization is indented relaxed-escaping JsonObject.ToJsonString with existing property order. Unchanged/malformed text is not reserialized. Existing filesystem write encoding/BOM behavior stays in FileSystemManager; do not replace it with independently encoded projected bytes.
- One pass is observable: for text “[A_ACTION: x] [B_ACTION: y] Choice”, a pass strips the first tag and can leave the second. A second pass changes visible text again while retaining existing inputValue. No “normalize until stable” loop, no blanket rejection of a valid single-pass result.

Use three distinct dispositions:
1. CurrentNoWriteEvaluation: current text needs no projection/fallback and shared semantic evaluation completes on actual bound reads. This is only this family’s present evaluation, not proof of historical first pass. It does not authorize replaying an earlier ambient timestamp parse; without the relevant actual first-pass parse observation it cannot become a history-complete family.
2. RetainedOrdinaryPass: actual ordinary invocation’s complete source observations, ordered issues, projection and returned write facts are retained and matched to present source. Its actual one-pass result need not be globally idempotent.
3. Unavailable(ProjectionRequired / MissingOrdinaryObservation / SourceChanged / SourceFault / InvocationIncomplete). These are admission-availability states, not additions to ordinary ValidationIssue lists.

If fallback is required without genuine ordinary writer observation, do not supply a dummy timestamp and do not call UtcNow in HOT. The existing wrapper remains the sampler and writer at its existing position. If a projection can be calculated without time, that detached proposed image is still not an observed write.

The timestamp validation leaf PI7052–7091 uses DateTimeOffset.TryParse with its existing ambient defaults, not strict invariant ISO parsing despite its message. Keep the actual call once in its actual ordinary position; no new clock/culture policy. Default parsing can depend on culture/local date/zone for incomplete date strings, so calling this leaf a wholly timeless pure kernel is unsound. Retain the actual input and returned parse diagnostic/disposition when used as historical hot evidence. Do not secretly reparse later under different ambient settings and call it the old observation. Exact independent cold replay for all such ordinary timestamp forms remains outside this bounded contract; changing accepted forms is not an authorized shortcut.

No clock sample is used by same-text freshness (A3118–3145), which emits only Warning. The separate canonical repair freshness owner uses physical mtime and historical repair boundaries (VR2688–2784); normalizer writes can change those mtimes. This family must not suppress/reorder those writes, convert warning→error, or treat its projection receipt as a replacement for that owner’s metadata/history proof.

1. New partial Services/Validation/ValidationService.NarrativeInterfacePolicy.cs:
- EvaluateNarrativeShape(string json, List<ValidationIssue> issues) returns response text/root disposition for the existing dependency continuation.
- EvaluateInterfaceShape(string json, List<ValidationIssue> issues).
- Existing TryFindTechnicalRepairLeakInNarrative, CollectAchievementNamesRequiringNarrativeMarkers, ParsePlayerSkillNames, quest-identity parsing, prose text assembly, claim/rationale predicates and ordinal delta-decision leaf remain the same functions or move verbatim here with value-only arguments.
- Keep timestamp parsing as a named ambient policy leaf, distinct from deterministic kernels.
Do not parse every dependency eagerly outside original try/catch boundaries. Keep exact helper ordering and accumulation; ordinary public methods must call these kernels immediately.

2. New partial ValidationService.NarrativeInterfaceSources.cs:
A private closed source reader with named roles, privately constructed only from the actual validator’s files and either its ordinary invocation or a genuine HOT Capturing owner/live lease. Suggested methods:
ReadCurrentTextAsync(NarrativeInterfaceRole role);
ReadOriginalPolicyTextAsync(NarrativeInterfaceRole role);
ObserveInterfaceExists();
RecordDomainCatch(Exception error);
RequireUnchangedAndNoSourceFault().
The role enum is exactly the eleven paths above; original methods accept only the nine original-capable roles. No arbitrary path string, caller map, callback/delegate reader, candidate overlay or global mutable override.

The ordinary adapter calls the existing real leaves with their existing semantics/read order. The HOT adapter reads actual live files under the SAME provided lease/G/current browser/Main owner, and derives original coordinates using genuine observed original authority. It must not recursively acquire leases, revive an expired reader, or replace actual original context checks with a parsed manifest. Nested original callback/rollback/context operations remain enrolled by the accepted observed-reader machinery. Per-role policy-null conversion must reproduce existing semantics; strict reader failure cannot be ignored as nullable “no delta”.

Reuse the accepted source-session contract: every read occurrence/presence/error recorded; repeated reads physically repeated; source faults latched before any domain catch; all captured current/original/control operations rechecked at family completion, and again before Capturing closes. Closed role sets constrain operations, not semantic authority. The return is immutable family data/provenance only; engine retains actual owner reference and original route, no public import constructor.

3. New partial ValidationService.NarrativeInterfaceInvocation.cs:
An owner-private OrdinaryOutputPolicyPass tracks NarrativeStarted→NarrativeReturned→InterfaceStarted→InterfaceReturned, or Incomplete. It retains actual validator/files identity, actual route/iteration association supplied by the owning engine through a genuine private owner, ordered read observations/branch outcomes, exact issues (including warnings), and projection events. No caller accepted bool or string selects authority. Public ordinary validators still return their existing List<ValidationIssue>; internal detailed overloads used by the actual engine can retain the same invocation’s data. They must not invoke public validation twice.

Projection event fields: fixed output role; source read occurrence and exact decoded before text/raw observation; actual ProjectedJson and Changed; fallback WasRequired/WasSampled/value only from existing A712; publication NotNeeded/Entered/Returned/Fault/Uncertain; actual final readback bytes and metadata if a genuine owning writer exposes them; source ordinal and real owning association. Retain thrown primary/close uncertainty as such. Use the exact existing public WriteFileAtomicAsync call for the ordinary path: FS764→WriteFileAtomicBytesAsync at840–853 acquires its owning lease and awaits ReleaseOwnedLeaseAsync(completed:false) before returning. Thus Returned records both this actual write and its successful owning release; an exception records incomplete/uncertain, never Returned. Record the actual input/projector output and this returned event in the wrapper without a new callback. For HOT association, a later bound ReadFileSnapshotAsync supplies actual physical bytes/mtime and checks them against FileSystemManager.EncodeUtf8WithPreamble(projected.Json), the SAME existing encoder (FS4337–4345); this comparison does not mint a historical publication receipt. It observes afterimage/metadata at its actual read time and cannot replace the separate repair-freshness history. Do not switch to WriteFileAtomicWithPublicationAsync just to obtain a result: it does not preserve the trusted-local branch of FS856–883. A future lower-level outcome retention, if actually necessary, must retain PublishOrdinaryFileWithOutcomeAsync on the trusted branch (TLS317–334) and the genuine canonical publication on the other branch, BEFORE facade/close, without rerunning either. No fabricated native proof or timestamp/GUID is needed.

4. Actual consumers:
- ValidationService public narrative/interface methods become the ordinary adapters over the shared kernels; sealed narrative readOnly API keeps its existing error semantics.
- GameEngine VR245/246 retains the same two actual invocations in existing order, including narrative’s read of PRE-interface-normalization text. No wrapping the whole game-state/health/progression loop under a new lease.
- New internal EvaluateHotNarrativeInterfaceAsync(genuineCapturingOwner, actualLease) uses only the read-only shared path or an actually retained prior pass. It runs before any prepared/cache/common seal, never attaches S/B to an already-built v2 candidate. It produces family availability/issues/source evidence, not full S.
- Existing afterlife SpiritualOriginalOutputProjection uses its own actual SpiritualWoundProjectionClock/retained inputs; do not repurpose it as a Mortal issuer or change its timing. Existing MortalJointAcceptedOutputBasis invariant/strict shape guard is a separate policy; do not replace ordinary timestamp/shape checks with it.

## First-pass history and the finite owner-adapter frontier

A valid current fixed-point image does not prove what narrative saw earlier. Preserve the actual sequence: narrative freshness/read→possible narrative write→achievement/prose reads (including then-current interface)→interface freshness/existence/read→possible interface UTC/write→interface semantic checks. Rechecking final bytes cannot recover pre-write interface/prose or stale-warning inputs.

Owned writes are explicit source transitions, not external drift exemptions. If an actual normalization occurs after accepted3b Ready custody captured those bytes, do not mutate/reseed that custody or silently bless the difference. Full HOT output-family integration must join the actual retained before→writer-return→after observations to the source/history owner before closing Capturing. Existing3b remains exact custody and can report SourceChanged; this consultation does not redesign it. If the actual corrected-Ready route reaches the private publisher without the requisite ordinary output pass, do not call the mutating validators under Lp to manufacture history. Report ProjectionRequired/MissingOrdinaryObservation and keep publication blocked.

Smallest coherent implementation can close kernels + ordinary real consumers + precise source-aware no-write family evaluation with explicit unavailable dispositions. Completing the general retained-pass route requires the actual engine invocation/writer observation adapter just specified, including owned transition association, the real public-write return/close and physical afterimage observation. That is routine engineering within the authorized direction, but is not already proved merely by defining event DTOs. It must have a real producer and consumer test before any family-complete claim. Full repair-history/cold semantics, canonical repair metadata freshness and the other five output families remain separately open; no new durable path/schema/GM field is proposed.

## Finite causal TDD sequence, all FUTURE_UNRUN

| Block | Genuine target and required contrast |
| --- | --- |
| Shared ordinary extraction | Existing AcceptedTurnNarrativePayloadValidationTests and AcceptedTurnInterfacePayloadNormalizationTests public entrypoints. Verify exact issue order/code/severity/message/actual, changed-only writes, malformed preservation, underscore/mixed-case fields, nullable options/image payload, malformed/non-object propagation and unchanged BOM/mtime. Unit sources demonstrate policy, not HOT authority. |
| Projection and time | Keep existing AfterlifeResourceCutoverTests.SpiritualOutputProjection ordinary-consumer tests (SP362–434) affected, not whole afterlife suite. Add two leading recognized tags to prove single-pass behavior; malformed/numeric/nonblank-invalid timestamp gets no fallback; useful null/blank payload timestamp does. Assert retained actual sample equals persisted timestamp; no extra sample on read-only reentry. Do not inject a clock as authority. |
| Achievement/prose order | Genuine original/current achievements unlock/new vs previous; duplicate previous identities preserves broad-catch behavior. Prose skill/quest claim, rationale, original equal versus changed, no-original filesModified fallback; current null=>empty; first-delta short circuit; repeated claim read ordering. Include narrative consuming raw pre-interface-normalization options and later owner retaining projected output. |
| Actual post-original owner | Reuse the accepted cheap genuine Stage prefix from HC238–265, not handmade snapshot test helpers. Seed only intended original sources before Stage and assert actual inventory coverage; author narrative/interface/skills/quests/Ready after original. Invoke actual ordinary validator owners once in engine order, retain actual results, then use genuine still-Capturing read-only consumer. No fake GameResponse or validator acceptance flag. One full joint test separately establishes its actual pre-seal consumption boundary. |
| Causal source drift | Alter captured A when later B opens through existing FS hooks; target current interface used by narrative, achievements, selected original/rollback, Ready/filesModified, debug rationale and a conditional delta source. Require sticky SourceChanged/SourceFault and no family proof, with unchanged genuine control. A swallowed achievements catch must not produce HOT success after read failure. No production test callback. |
| Missing/uncertain writer | Original ordinary caller still normalizes lawful data; HOT with missing required first-pass observation returns unavailable, never a new ordinary rejection. Real write failure/uncertainty cannot be recorded Returned; exact retry uses same retained result, no resampling/projection loop. Mutation of exported diagnostic arrays cannot alter live observations. |
| Inter-family boundary | Other Full reasoning/special action/combat/pending-memory/no-offer and automatic policies are not skipped or deemed covered by this family. Original/canonical repair freshness remains separately required. No candidate retrofit/second reducer. |

First REDs must target actual missing source-bound/detailed owner observation or demonstrate a real read-drift path; a pure projector test alone is not HOT evidence. Keep categories finite ≤5m, selector responsibility reviewed, no repeated unchanged reader131 or broad lifecycle/afterlife sweep. Root will preserve and independently review before implementation release.

## Remaining limits

This closes the proposed shared policy/IO decomposition and identifies its concrete existing consumers. It does not assert implementation or qualification. The general first-pass writer/history join, retention of the existing real writer return/close plus observed afterimage, ambient timestamp historical/cold equivalence, and full source-session adapter are named finite prerequisites where source currently lacks the adapter. Missing APIs are engineering tasks, not a request for another principled grant or F2. Valid ordinary narrative/interface output stays valid under its existing single-pass policies.

No new clocks, IDs, scheduler/reducer/reward/time replay, output schema/GM field, P/A/M3 path, public QTE, activation or T197 engineering. Full S/F1/cold/P0/M3 and existing D4/guided/visual/Windows/D8 gates stay open.
